item_shape.user_impact: What user-facing problem or consistency gain this addresses.

classification_rules.definite_drift: Existing primitive/pattern fits without API change and behavior is simple.
classification_rules.primitive_gap: Should use primitive, but primitive API must first support behavior/accessibility/layout.
classification_rules.shared_pattern: Repeated SlateCamp-specific product meaning across multiple surfaces.
classification_rules.intentional_custom: Custom is justified by domain behavior, canvas/performance, loading/progress, or approved one-off visual direction.
classification_rules.decision_needed: Ambiguous product/design intent; requires Philip decision before implementation.
